maya (product): quick sync — Customer Z asked for per-project API tokens that can be limited to only chat, only embeddings, or only rerank/tool access. they also want predictable rotation with instant revoke. need to figure out API surface + launch bar.
ryan (eng): is the idea JWT-style claims on the key? e.g. `scope:chat`, `project:proj-z`, `roles:[\"rerank\"]`
alex (api): we already attach metadata to keys but enforcement today is coarse. enforcing per-endpoint scope means an extra check in the request path. caching helps but we need invalidate-on-rotate. perf hit = ~1 small lookup unless we cache in-proc.
kim (security): rotate/invalidate semantics are the hard part. require immediate revocation option, audit logs for key use, and KMS/HSM integration for key material. also need TTL for caches.
sam (solutions): customers will expect zero-downtime rotate — pattern: create new key, switch callers, then revoke old after grace window. support for 'rotate-and-grace' API would be nice.
maya (product): draft launch criteria: 1) policy schema for key scopes (chat|embeddings|rerank|tools) defined; 2) server-side enforcement + tests; 3) rotation API + SDK helpers; 4) docs + migration guide; 5) audit logs and billing attribution per project.
claire (pm): for scope negotiation propose MVP: coarse scopes = `chat`, `embeddings`, `tools` (tools covers all function/tool calling). defer per-tool ACLs to post-MVP.
ryan (eng): for function/tool calling we should fail-fast: if key lacks `tools` scope and model tries to call a tool we should return 403 and a clear structured error. falling back to a model variant that doesn't call tools is an alternative but tricky.
alex (api): example enforcement snippet:
```
// simplified runtime check
if (!key.scopes.includes('tools') && request.uses_tool) {
  return { status: 403, error: 'key_missing_scope:tools' }
}
```
maya (product): billing note — need per-key/project cost attribution for embeddings and rerank. metrics surfaced in console.
kim (security): rotation strategy options: immediate revoke (push invalidation), revoke-with-grace (short TTL + mark revoked), or automated swap (support rotate endpoint that returns both old/new). we should support pubsub invalidation to avoid stale caches.
ryan (eng): implementation idea: key metadata in Redis with short TTL + in-proc cache. use Redis pubsub channel `key-updates` to broadcast revokes so canaries plus runtime nodes invalidate quickly.
deploy-bot: deploy:service/api v1.42 -> canary ✅
sam (solutions): question — should embeddings scoped to a project be retrievable by other projects with a shared org key? customers ask about cross-project retrieval; default should be isolation unless org-admin enables cross-project read.
claire (pm): action items: (1) maya to draft spec doc by EOD Friday; (2) alex to open API contract PR by next Wed; (3) kim to schedule security review; (4) ryan to prototype runtime cache+pubsub pattern.
maya (product): thanks. tagging folks for follow-up: @ryan (eng) @alex (api) @kim (security) @sam (solutions) :thumbsup:
